title: Utsav: Patterns
seo_title: Patterns Class 1 Worksheet with Answers (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 9)
standard_text: Patterns: identifying, describing and extending repeating patterns of shapes, colours, sounds and numbers (summary of NCERT Joyful Mathematics Class 1)
meta_desc: Class 1 Utsav worksheet (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 9): repeating patterns, what comes next, the repeating part, missing pieces and number patterns. 100 picture questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A pattern repeats the same part again and again: red, blue, red, blue, …
  • Find the repeating part, then continue it.

Examples

Example

What comes next: ▲ ● ▲ ● ▲ …?

▲ ● repeats

Answer: ●

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Copying only the last shapeFind the whole part that repeats.
Missing a gap in the middleSay the pattern aloud from the start.

faq.a: A pattern where the same group of things comes again and again.
In rangoli, garlands, clothes and festival decorations.

items.q: What goes in the two gaps? Read from left to right.

items.q: Fatima made a repeating pattern, but she made one mistake. Which bead is wrong?

items.q: Vivaan made a repeating pattern, but he made one mistake. Which shape is wrong?

items.q: Manav threads this repeating unit 3 times. How many beads does he use?
items.e: Each unit has 3 beads. 3, 6, 9. Manav uses 9 beads. 6 is only 2 beads in each unit.

items.q: Dev makes this repeating unit 5 times. How many flags are there?
items.e: Each unit has 2 flags. 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. There are 10 flags. 5 counts the units, not the flags.

items.q: Shreya draws this repeating unit 2 times. How many shapes does she draw?
items.e: Each unit has 4 shapes. 4 + 4 = 8. 4 is only one unit. 2 counts the units.

items.q: Harsh keeps going with this pattern. He uses 8 red beads in all. How many blue beads does he use?
items.e: The unit is red, blue. Each red bead has one blue bead after it. 8 red beads, so 8 blue beads.
